variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash. openFPGALoader writes the SPI flash through the ECP5's JTAG port. Not tried on hardware. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware. USB filter (2026-11-05): "Lattice ECP5 Evaluation Board" is the product name fujprog looks for on 0403:6010 (kost/fujprog fujprog.c, cable_hw_map). Also accepts the FT2232H's factory name, as the Versa's filter accepts its chip's, in case a board ships without the Lattice name (not checked).
